components.name: Combobox
components.summary: A text field with suggestions over Base UI Autocomplete (a popup listbox under the field).

props.name: autoHighlight
props.doc: true: the first row highlights while filtering; "always": also before any typing.

props.name: cancelOnBlur
props.doc: Keep a multi-control panel open when focus moves to its buttons.

props.name: completeOnTab
props.doc: Set false when Tab should move focus to the next control.

props.name: completionText
props.doc: Readable Tab completion for suggestions identified by an opaque key.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The field's text when it opens.

props.name: empty
props.doc: The line shown when there are no suggestions ("No matches"). It is Base UI's live Empty part (`role="status"`, polite), so a screen reader hears it as the list empties.

props.name: inline
props.doc: Render the suggestions under the field in place (inside a popover) instead of in a popup.

props.name: inputRow
props.doc: Content alongside the field, inside the search row.

props.name: isItemCurrent
props.doc: The committed choice, distinct from the transient keyboard highlight.

props.name: isItemDisabled
props.doc: Disabled rows remain visible but cannot be highlighted or submitted.

props.name: itemLabel
props.doc: A rich row's accessible name; its identity remains the stable suggestion string.

props.name: keepHeight
props.doc: With `inline`: the list keeps its tallest height while mounted (until the window resizes), so narrowing it never resizes the popover and a field above it never moves under the caret (cx-6k6cg). For a list with no empty-state message of its own after it.

props.name: listEnd
props.doc: A line in the list's place (a list's "nothing here yet"): with `pinnedSuggestions`, after the scrolling rows and before bottom-pinned actions, so it never lands under them; without, after the list. Not a row: the arrows never reach it. With `pinnedSuggestions` it sits inside the listbox (the pinned actions are options of the same list), in a `role="presentation"` wrapper, so it takes non-interactive text only: no buttons, links or live regions (an action belongs in `pinnedSuggestions`). The native popup (`native`, when the host draws the list) does not draw it.

props.name: native
props.type: { model: NativePopupDescription; anchor?: () => HTMLElement | null; onEvent?(event: NativePopupEvent): void; onDismiss?(): void; }
props.doc: Declarative native rows. When the host is available the web list is not mounted.

props.name: onCancel
props.doc: Escape, or focus leaving the field.

props.name: onCommand
props.doc: Handle a shortcut while the Base UI input owns focus. `preventDefault` skips the Combobox's own handling; `preventBaseUIHandler` also skips Base UI's (Return clicking the highlighted row).

props.name: onHighlight
props.doc: The highlighted suggestion changed; undefined when none is. `by` says whether the arrow keys ("keyboard") or the pointer ("pointer") moved it, so a caller can treat a passing pointer as less deliberate than a key press.

props.name: onQuery
props.doc: The text changed (typing, completion): compute new suggestions.

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Return: the highlighted suggestion, else the text.

props.name: pinnedSuggestions
props.doc: Actions that stay put while the remaining suggestions scroll: below the field, or with `pinnedPlacement: "bottom"` under the list (the arrows reach them after the last row either way).

props.name: renderItem
props.doc: A row's content (a name over a path); default: the suggestion text. The row still submits and completes its suggestion string.

props.name: rootClassName
props.doc: Class for the Base UI root when the field and list are laid out together.

props.name: virtualRows
props.doc: Only the scrolling rows near the viewport are in the DOM (TanStack Virtual over the list's scroller), so a list of thousands (the Projects picker, Leo 2026-11-04: "opening the project picker lags like shit since we have so many") opens in a frame. With `pinnedSuggestions` this windows at any length; any list windows past COMBOBOX_VIRTUAL_AFTER rows without it. `estimate` is a row's height in pixels before it is measured (default 28). `sizeKey` is a string that differs whenever a row's outer size can differ without its border box changing (a section heading drawn in the row's margin): a row whose `sizeKey` changes remounts and is measured again, and its size for one value is never reused for another.

components.name: VirtualList
components.summary: A virtualized list over TanStack Virtual.

props.name: activeIndex
props.doc: The highlighted row: always rendered, scrolled into view when its index or its row's React key (the count, for a row without a key) changes, so a filter that keeps the highlight at 0 still shows its first result.

props.name: activeScrollKey
props.doc: Changes when the same index names a different result set or active item (for rows without keys).

props.name: estimateSize
props.doc: Row height in pixels (rows may differ; this is the estimate before measuring).

props.name: fade
props.doc: Fade overflowing rows on this list's own viewport.

props.name: itemKey
props.doc: The row's own identity (a task id). Measured heights are kept by it, so a row keeps its height when rows before it leave or move. Without it they are kept by index, and the rows after a change are placed with their old neighbors' heights until measured again (TanStack Virtual `getItemKey`).

props.name: measureRows
props.doc: Rows size to their content: each is measured once rendered, and `estimateSize` is only the first guess.

props.name: renderRow
props.type: (index: number, style: CSSProperties, measure?: (element: Element | null) => void) => ReactNode
props.doc: `measure` is set when `measureRows` is on: the row passes it as its `ref`, with `data-index={index}`.

props.name: role
props.doc: The list's ARIA role and name (listbox, grid, ...); rows set theirs in renderRow.

props.name: rowCount
props.doc: With `role="grid"`: the whole list's row count (aria-rowcount), since only some rows are mounted; rows then carry their own aria-rowindex.

props.name: scrollParent
props.doc: Use the closest matching ancestor as the viewport instead of creating a nested scroller.

props.name: tabIndex
props.doc: A list that takes the keyboard itself (DrillList under a key style): -1, and its keys.
